title: CONNECT-UDP HTTP/3 Request Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9298 HTTP/3 CONNECT-UDP request-policy surface.
scope: This verification covers HTTP/3 CONNECT-UDP request-header construction, connect-udp protocol-token validation, Capsule-Protocol requirement, no-content request policy, 2xx successful-response policy, successful-response no-content policy, Capsule Protocol response constraints, and failed-response abort decisions.
preconditions: RFC 9297 Capsule Protocol support is trace-clean.
RFC 9298 URI Template and target validation is trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9298-0001`.
expected_result: The focused request-policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 request-policy artifacts, generated triage reflects the slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9298 HTTP/3 CONNECT-UDP request-policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. HTTP/1.1 upgrade behavior, context-id framing, UDP socket lifecycle, forwarding, congestion, ECN, and vulnerable-target filtering remain future RFC 9298 slices.
